facts.text: University of Charleston offers 3-Year Fast Track programs in areas including Biology, Communication, and Radiology.

sources.title: Fast Track/Direct Pathway Options - University of Charleston
sources.quote: Fast Track programs can help you complete your undergraduate degree sooner – sometimes in as few as 3 years.

facts.text: Students in the BSBA/MBA program complete their undergraduate business degree in three years and transition into the MBA program to earn both degrees in four years.

sources.title: Fast Track/Direct Pathway Options - University of Charleston
sources.quote: Students complete their undergraduate business degree in three years, then transition into the MBA program for their final summer, fall, and spring semesters.
